browserCases: Four real HLS streams decode and play.
Focused controls appear on mouse movement, hide after three idle seconds, and hide when the pointer leaves.
Custom player pause and play affect only the focused stream.
Focus moves the controls without reloading media and keeps one audible stream; volume changes the media volume.
Manual 180p and 360p selections change decoded video resolution; Auto remains selectable.
Stream fullscreen contains both the video and its custom controls.
Changing focus exits the old stream fullscreen and reveals the new controls.
Picture-in-picture opens; media play/pause events keep the custom controls synchronized.
Custom playback controls work in single-game layout and restore the four-stream layout.
Focused controls fit a 390px viewport without horizontal page overflow.
A manual feed stops at the final-game deadline, closes its session, and stays saved in preferences.
A live HLS manifest exposes DVR seeking and Go Live returns to the safe live position.
Restored live provider games start automatically without a Play game click.
Listed provider playback uses the shared controls; server changes preserve pause and reset quality to Auto.
A live provider EOS retries; a backup discovered after open reaches the player on PATCH and plays after primary failure.
A media failure during an in-flight heartbeat is queued and recovers after the heartbeat finishes.
An offline fatal playlist and startup timeout wait for connectivity, then reload without penalizing the source.
Paused, hidden, and wake-from-sleep media faults reload locally without marking the provider failed.
A paused or offline stream does not fail over; a live video that stops advancing refreshes once.
Expired provider playlists refresh once and recover on a backup server.
Unavailable providers refresh, try the backup, and expose a retry control after exhaustion.
Live status and newly listed sources auto-connect; focused pause survives refresh, and re-added live games auto-start.
Started streams keep playing when scores mark a game final or its directory link disappears.
Four quality options are fully visible; the Quality heading stays fixed while the options scroll.
